content: Sports Insights (maker of Bet Labs, the product this phase clones) publishes: 20 games needs ~80% win rate to be meaningful; 200 games needs low-60s% win rate; 1,000+ games makes 55%+ win rate meaningful; 2,000 games at 57% win rate gives ~95% confidence of beating the 55% break-even vig threshold. Practical floor is 50-100 bets to 'start telling a story', 200-500 preferred, 1,000+ ideal.
